claim: A rotating sector (615/617) uses one marker: its x/y is the pivot, so its absolute position matters, and its ang is the total turn, not a heading. Angles wrap at 2048 (Sin/Cos mask with 2047), so whole circles spin and come back: a tutorial gear turns 20480 (ten revolutions), a door -1024 or 512.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:2232 (trInit: marker0 passed as pivot and its ang as the end turn); trig.cpp:47 RotatePoint; trig.h:34-42 Sin/Cos index costable with & 2047.
maps/blood/mechanism/Vanilla/MACHINERY-GEAR.map s1 (marker sprite 11, ang 20480) and s3 (sprite 33, ang -1024); maps/blood/mechanism/#SWDOOR.MAP s1 ang 512, s2 ang -512.
use: Put the marker on the hinge or axle; write the turn as an angle in 2048ths, signed.
